title: Uniform Concentration for $α$-subexponential Random Operators
summary: Random matrices acting on structured sets play a fundamental role in high-dimensional geometry, compressed sensing, and randomized algorithms. Existing results primarily focus on subgaussian models, when random matrices act as near-isometries on sets with optimal tail behavior. Nevertheless, very often in applications we deal with distributions with heavy tails that are not subgaussian but have at least exponential-type tails.
